title: Affeer
summary: AFFEE'R, verb transitive To confirm. [Not used.] AFFEE'R, verb transitive In law, to assess or reduce an arbitrary penalty or amercement to a precise sum; to reduce a general amercement to a sum certa

inlines.v: AFFEE'R, verb transitive To confirm. [Not used.] AFFEE'R, verb transitive In law, to assess or reduce an arbitrary penalty or amercement to a precise sum; to reduce a general amercement to a sum certain, according to the circumstances of the case.
